text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: What the heck?! I'm feelin' super powerful all of a sudden!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: Have you goddesses been watchin' over me this whole time? And not just when I'm crackin' jokes, but when I've been runnin', too?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: I'll put in tons of effort to thank ya! So keep your eyes on the new Mega White Lightnin'!
